facts.activity_file: charging, tying in and guarding a blast

control_failures.control_label: guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast
receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: injury during cleaning and preparation on P-9503

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BLAST_GUARDING_AND_CLEARANCE: the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control EXPLOSIVES_RECONCILIATION: the receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives on P-9503 and PT-9503 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in charging and firing, specifically charging, tying in and guarding a blast. P-9503 (dewatering pumps) is in service for pit dewatering. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast was not in place. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 3 February 2025 an incident occurred on P-9503 and PT-9503 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during cleaning and preparation, releasing kinetic energy held as rotating equipment.
